latestVersion.changelog:
Bing AI Video Creator — Initial Release

- Create high-quality 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts or uploaded images.
- Supports JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV uploads up to 200MB; output delivered in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic backend setup with free credit/token management for new users.
- Built-in workflows for marketers, content creators, and social media managers.
- Supports video editing actions, timeline previews, and batch processing.
- Clear error handling and messaging for unsupported files, credit limits, and export issues.
